children: DIRTT Environmental Solutions entered into an irrevocable standby letter of credit to support funding under its C$15.0 million BDC Facility. Issued by Royal Bank of Canada in favor of Business Development Bank of Canada, the C$3.5 million instrument allows BDC to draw in partial or multiple demands. The letter of credit has an initial one-year term and automatically renews annually unless non-renewed. Management expects the arrangement to bolster liquidity and satisfy conditions tied to the term loan facility.
: Royal Bank of Canada and Business Development Bank of Canada
: Support BDC Facility funding and enhance liquidity
